title: haex-hive Publisher Root Manifest v2
description: Schema for the root manifest.json of a publisher repo. Maps atom-ids to internal directory paths. See spec-007 FR-007, FR-011.

publisher.description: Publisher's reverse-DNS namespace. Every atom-id key in atoms MUST start with publisher + '.'.

atoms.description: Map from atom-id to the publisher-repo-relative directory containing that atom's manifest.json.

repoRelativePath.description: Repository-relative POSIX path, no leading/trailing slash, no NUL. Segment-level rejection of . and .. is enforced at runtime, not by pattern.

path.description: Directory (not file) containing the atom's manifest.json.

description.description: Human-readable one-liner shown by future haex atoms list command (Spec 010).
